subject: Edgeware — private install SKU partitioning & transition discount ask
messages:
From: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@edgeware.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@edgeware.com
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment options — clarifications on SKU split and fees

Hi Mina / Aditya,

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Edgeware is trying to finalize commercial assumptions for the private install (VPC + on-prem) and we need a clear SKU/fee breakdown for the SOW. A few clarification asks from procurement:

- Can you confirm the platform fee is charged per-deployment or per-org for hybrid setups? Our infra will be split across two regions (east/west).
- We need an itemized SKU list: reserved nodes, engineering retainer, optional on-call SME, and migration credit line. Will you provide unit prices and suggested sizing?
- For a 3-year commit (initial contract + two annual renewals) what discount bands do you offer on the platform fee and dedicated node pricing?
- Is Redwood able to offer a one-time migration credit to offset professional services if we hit the commit?
- Payment terms: procurement prefers Net45; standard in our org is Net30. Any flexibility?

I've attached our RFP extract to this email (Edgeware_RFP_2026_Q2.pdf). Can you respond with a simple commercial term sheet and a draft SOW by next Friday (7/9)?

Cheers,
Liam
--
Liam O'Connell
Head of Procurement, Edgeware Systems
liam.oconnell@edgeware.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Edgeware RFP — pricing asks (internal)

Team — forwarding Edgeware's RFP excerpt and procurement list. They want SKU-level clarity and a 3-year discount band plus a migration credit ask. Key constraints: dual-region private deployment, want Net45.

Quick thoughts: we can treat platform fee as per-organization with an add-on per-region routing fee; that avoids double-charging while preserving our support cost basis. For migration credits we can structure as a capped credit tied to committed spend (e.g., $Xk credit at 20% of first-year committed spend).

Marissa — can you draft a compact pricing sheet (unit prices + recommended sizing) and two commercial options: 1) aggressive 3-year commit (larger migration credit, deeper node discount) and 2) conservative (1-year + optional renewals) with standard platform fee. Include an SOW outline for engineering runbook and cutover retainer.

David — help with on-call SME pricing and how that maps to support tier (Standard vs Premium). Aditya — any notes on amortizing the platform fee vs capitalization that we should flag for the finance/enterprise buyer?

Let's aim to turn this into a short packet for Liam by 7/8 end of day so Mina can send on 7/9.

Thanks,
Mina
--
Mina Haddad
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 11:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edgeware RFP — pricing asks (pricing packet attached)

Mina — attached is a first-pass commercial packet (Redwood_VPC_Prices_Q3_2026.xlsx) and a draft SOW (SOW_Draft_Edgeware.docx). Highlights: 

- Platform fee model: single org platform fee ($75k/year) + regional routing add-on ($10k/year per additional region). For their two-region setup I'd recommend platform fee $75k + regional add-on $10k for the second region.
- Reserved GPUs: suggested initial pool 8 reserved nodes (A100-equivalent), list price $16k/node/month; 3-year commit pricing reduces node rate by 18% at >36 months commit and volume bands.
- Migration/implementation credits: propose a $60k one-time migration credit tied to a 3-year committed ARR >= $1.2M. Credit netted off first invoice.
- Support tiers: Standard (8x5) included up to the platform fee; Premium (24x7 + named SME on-call) as add-on $45k/year. On-call SME hourly rate included as an overage at $250/hr; recommend we offer a retainer bundle (200 hours) at $40k for the initial 6 months.
- Payment terms: Net30 standard; offer Net45 if they accept 10% prepayment or higher commit / PO milestone.

I left room for negotiations: standard commercial option (no migration credit, Net30) and commit option (3-year, $60k credit, 18% node discount, Net45).

If this looks good I'll turn into a one-page term sheet for Mina to send.

Attachments: Redwood_VPC_Prices_Q3_2026.xlsx; SOW_Draft_Edgeware.docx

Best,
Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Pricing, Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@edgeware.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@edgeware.com, legal@edgeware.com
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edgeware — private install SKU partitioning & transition discount ask

Mina — thanks for the packet, Marissa. A few follow-ups from procurement and legal: 

- The platform fee + regional add-on approach is acceptable, but given the scale we're expecting (expansion to APAC in year 2) we'd need a clearer cap on regional add-ons and a migration credit that covers at least 50% of PS estimate. Your $60k proposal is lower than our internal PS estimate (~$120k). Can you stretch on that?
- On the 3-year pricing: the 18% node discount is close, but because we will bring a multi-product contract (we're also evaluating embeddings + dedicated reranking work), we'd need 25% off node list price to sign at 3yrs.
- Payment terms: procurement will accept Net45 if Redwood can either (a) apply a 5% discount on platform fee for Net45, or (b) provide a letter of credit milestone schedule.
- Support: we'd like the Premium support retainer to include a guaranteed named SME response SLA (4hrs for Sev1) and 100 hours of migration in the retainer (not 200).

Can you respond with a counter that adjusts the migration credit and node discount bands and confirms the Net45 concession path? Also please include a short SOW appendix showing milestone-based invoicing for the migration.

Thanks — aiming to finalize with legal by 7/16 if we can get counters this week.

Regards,
Liam
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@edgeware.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Jul 2026 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edgeware — private install SKU partitioning & transition discount ask

Liam — appreciate the clear asks. We can be flexible to close this this month. Summary of our counter (one-page term sheet attached inline):

- Migration credit: increased to $100k, applied to first invoice, contingent on 3-year ARR commit >= $1.2M and signature within 30 days.
- Node discount: we can move to 22% off node list price at 3-year commit with a pathway to 25% if you commit to both embeddings and reranking (multi-product addendum).
- Platform fee / regional add-ons: keep platform fee $75k/year + $10k/regional add-on; cap regional add-ons at 2 add-ons for year 1 and freeze add-on price for the full term if signed by 7/31.
- Payment terms: we will accept Net45 if Edgeware provides a 10% prepayment on the first-year invoice OR signs a milestone-based PO with a confirmed first milestone at 30% prepay. The 5% discount for Net45 is not something we can do across the board, but we can instead apply a one-time onboarding credit of $15k if you choose Net45 without prepay.
- Support: Premium retainer will include named SME with 4hr Sev1 response SLA and 100 hours migration support in the initial 6-month retainer at $40k. Any additional on-call will be at the standard rate.

I've attached: one-page term sheet and a draft SOW appendix with milestone invoicing and acceptance criteria. If this aligns, I'll ask Legal to produce an addendum and we can route DocuSign (link below) for signature.

Next steps: 1) confirm which commercial option (3-yr multi-product vs 3-yr single-product) 2) sign term sheet 3) finalize SOW. If you confirm the multi-product addendum we can hit the 25% node discount and expand the migration credit to $120k.

DocuSign: https://docusign.example/sign/EDGE-2026-073
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example/deal/EDGE-2026-073
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/edgeware-redwood-sow

Thanks — happy to hop on a final alignment call if helpful.

Best,
Mina
--
Mina Haddad
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
